The hang that blocked strength numbers was a crash hidden by PBDebug.logonerr's uncommented pbPrintException call (a nil $ItemData); it is fixed. baseline_0_1_0 is retained for comparison but is superseded by archetype_0_6_2.

probe_0_6_2.note: no card Portable fails that stock passes, on the corrected engine: stock fails 48 cards, Portable 14, and the 14 are a subset. The remaining failures are dominated by this adapter using stock pbGetMoveScore as base evidence where the Reborn adapter uses a flat 100.

Confirmed by re-running the stock probe with the fix reverted: it reproduces 204 exactly. Five cards fail and three pass once item data is loaded, netting -2. Portable's total is 240 either way, though its per-card results also move.

tier_0_6_2.schedule: tier -- every ordered non-mirror pairing of each set's four teams, 5 seeds, 2 arms
tier_0_6_2.tiers: gen6ou only -- Realidea ships all 29 Z-crystals as items and implements no Z-move engine, so 24 of gen7ou's 26 sample teams would import holding an inert item
tier_0_6_2.control: stock vs stock is 58W/58L = 50.0% over the symmetric schedule; the gap is the seat swap, not the schedule
caveats: errors are engine faults in Realidea's own code, not policy failures, and are excluded from win rates
all six timeouts are portable battles at the 100-round cap; pbStartBattle discards the cap's verdict, so timeout_result carries it separately

traced_set.observation_free: the traced run reproduces the untraced one exactly (41/12/6/1 and 32/25/0/3, same win rates and mean turns), so tracing costs nothing in outcome
limits: portable arm only -- run_one stamps a trace for mode=portable, so there is no stock-side decision record
decisions, not outcomes: no hit/miss/crit/Protect. This gauntlet records no event stream
a turn with no line is one Portable did not decide (fell through to stock, or the actor could not act)
race is keyed by battler seat, not party slot; the record carries no per-turn foe identity

mega_evolution.forms: 46 mega species (Charizard and Mewtwo have X and Y) + 2 primal reversions
mega_evolution.ai: pbEnemyShouldMegaEvolve? is 'always if possible'; Portable's override calls it on the same line the stock path does, so mega is policy-neutral between arms
mega_evolution.harness_gate: pbCanMegaEvolve? returns false unless $game_switches[512] or [234]; a save-less harness leaves both false. The gauntlet sets 512 (key mega=, default on). 234 is deliberately not set: it triggers a cut-in that blocks on Kernel.pbMessage.
mega_evolution.verified: same matchup and seed with mega on vs off diverges (stock 20 vs 17 turns, portable 16 vs 19)
